Hi Kajal, welcome! It's great to finally meet you.  Thanks for coming in today. I've reviewed your resume and am impressed with your projects, particularly the inventory management system and the expense tracker.  Your skills in Java, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and SQL are very relevant to many of the roles we have available.

To get started, could you please tell me a little bit about yourself?  I'd love to hear about your background, your interests within the tech field, and what you're hoping to achieve in your career.

Kajal, thank you so much for taking the time to speak with me today. I've truly appreciated learning more about your experience and skills;  it's been a valuable conversation.  The team will be reviewing all applications, and we’ll be in touch within [ timeframe, e.g., the next week ] to let you know the next steps in the process.  Thank you again, and have a wonderful day.
